units.source_text: 金刚院的佛殿建在更高处。

en.t: Kongoin's Buddhist hall stands on higher ground.

units.source_text: 过了独木桥，右侧是王重塔，左侧是枫林，

en.t: After crossing the log bridge, the Wangzhong Pagoda is on the right, and a maple grove is on the left,

units.source_text: 再往里走，就可以看见巍然的一百零五级缀满苦踪的石阶。

en.t: and if you go farther in, you can see the imposing one hundred and five limestone steps, covered with traces of hardship.

units.source_text: 这是石灰石台阶，容易沿跤。

en.t: These are limestone steps, and it is easy to slip and fall on them.
